description: Figure 15 (“Token Ratio (TR).”) is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating token ratio values across several evaluation sets for three models. The horizontal axis contains the category labels PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, arranged left to right, and each category displays three adjacent bars; the vertical axis is not explicitly labeled and shows no visible tick marks, but numeric values are printed above each bar. The legend indicates three series: RedWhale (our) shown in dark purple, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 shown in light blue, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) shown in light gray. For PT-EVAL, the dark purple bar is labeled 0.42, the light blue bar 0.46, and the light gray bar 1.00; for KoBEST-BQ, the values are 0.52 (dark purple), 0.56 (light blue), and 1.00 (light gray); for KoBEST-CP, 0.70 (dark purple), 0.74 (light blue), and 1.00 (light gray); for KoBEST-HS, 0.50 (dark purple), 0.54 (light blue), and 1.00 (light gray); for KoBEST-SN, 0.69 (dark purple), 0.73 (light blue), and 1.00 (light gray); and for AVG, 0.57 (dark purple), 0.61 (light blue), and 1.00 (light gray). The bars are not shown as sorted by value, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the value labels above the bars.
